description.en: PolyWorkBench evaluates LLM agents on multilingual, long-horizon workplace workflows across five domains: commerce, knowledge work, legal analysis, localization, and manufacturing. It includes 67 tasks, structured scoring via Grade, executable state verification with Pytest, and LLM-as-Judge diagnostics.

evidence.snippet: We introduce PolyWorkBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate LLM agents on multilingual, long-horizon workplace workflows.

claire_radar.motivation: While Large Language Model (LLM) agents excel at monolingual long-horizon planning and tool use, enterprise workflows inherently require processing multilingual resources across extended trajectories.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: This benchmark fills the gap of evaluating LLM agents on tasks that combine multilinguality and long-horizon execution, providing a structured protocol to compare agent performance and identify systematic failure modes in cross-lingual scenarios.
